engine.notes: Dallas lost Dallas Comedy House in 2020; Stomping Ground is now the training hub and Dallas Comedy Club in Deep Ellum its show-side successor, but DCC's site timed out on every attempt so it is unlisted here. Plano, Irving and Addison have Improv-branded clubs that are stand-up rooms, not improv theaters.

entries.name: Stomping Ground Comedy Theater
entries.summary: A non-profit improv theater and school, incorporated 2017, at 1350 Manufacturing Street #109, with a six-level core curriculum starting October 2026, monthly shows like Thunderdome and programs for retirees and neurodiverse learners.
entries.schedule: Levels One-Six start October 18-22, 2026; Thunderdome first Fridays 9pm; Shenanigans first Saturdays 6pm
signals: Improv for Retirees and neurodiverse learners
entries.reasons: Its own venue, a complete six-level ladder with October 2026 dates and inclusive programs; a younger theater whose shows are monthly rather than nightly.

entries.name: Four Day Weekend
entries.summary: The DFW audience-suggestion comedy institution with more than 25 years of Friday and Saturday shows, theaters in Fort Worth and Dallas, a bestselling book and the 4U comedy classes.
entries.schedule: Shows every Friday and Saturday night, $30
signals: Theaters in Fort Worth and Dallas
entries.reasons: Long-running weekend shows and strong standing, but the site posts no dates, no class levels and no Dallas address on the pages that would load.
